# Third-party BigGrep sources

`biggrep-2.7.2-source.zip` is copied from the BigGrep source archive shipped
in the supplied `azul-plugin-retrohunt-main` project. It is NOT authored by
this project and is used to build the unmodified `bgindex` command.

Upstream: https://github.com/cmu-sei/BigGrep

Preserve the upstream copyright and licence notices in the archive, including
`LICENSE.txt`. BigGrep's licence is separate from this repository's licence.
Review redistribution obligations before publishing a container or source release.
